content: The question types were derived after the manual evaluation of 1,721 consumer health questions. Our taxonomy includes 16 types about Diseases, 20 types about Drugs and one type (Information) for the other named entities such as Procedures, Medical exams and Treatments. We describe below the considered question types and examples of associated question patterns.
